name: zvideo_commit_fog_color_if_changed
description: zVideo::CommitFogColorIfChanged copies pending fog RGB255 values to the applied fog color and calls the renderer update callback only when any channel changed.
known_limits: Binary Ninja evidence shows the original tail-jumps through g_zVideo_pfnUpdateFogColor; the functional source uses the typed callback call and leaves tier S verification to a coherent zVideo/zRndr fog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4a7330 shows x87 equality checks against all applied/pending RGB255 channels, a return when all match, pending-to-applied copies when any channel differs, and an indirect jump through g_zVideo_pfnUpdateFogColor.

The native smoke verifies no callback when pending equals applied, exact pending/applied RGB255 writes when changed, one renderer update callback on change, and no repeated callback after the copied state is current.
